Heavy Water moderates almost as well as light water but absorbs far fewer neutrons, so a heavy-water core runs on poorer fuel.
# The Heavy Water Tower
A square box of Heavy Water Tower Casing, 3 to 5 blocks across and 4 to 8 tall, the controller in a wall, Exchange Trays inside (the rest may be air).

# The Girdler sulfide process
Water and Hydrogen Sulfide trade deuterium between a cold and a hot section. Each Exchange Tray takes 1,000 mB of Water, 10 mB of Hydrogen Sulfide and 100 mB of Steam every 2 seconds and makes 5 mB of Heavy Water, using 30 FE/t. Every tray works at once, so more trays make more.
Ports: Input for the three fluids, Output for the Heavy Water, Energy.
